14010a8a98db1d92257da331d2ffdb9505954b5c.LogDescription: Deliver Sintar's Vaccine to Soar Hawkfury at Agmar's Hammer.
14010a8a98db1d92257da331d2ffdb9505954b5c.QuestDescription: <Doctor Malefious hands you a vial full of murky liquid.>$B$BHere you are then, $r. Take this back to the cow and let him know that all debts have been paid. We are officially "square."$B$BNow leave me before I set Jennings upon you.

1402209c0f419d4f681dccb5cc30e55d7338b7c6.Text: Madness has brought you here to me. I shall be your undoing!

1402eab335a26b497e244f5c6e9586a286562878.LogDescription: Glorthal Stiffbeard at Frosthold wants you to kill Sirana Iceshriek.
1402eab335a26b497e244f5c6e9586a286562878.QuestDescription: This Sirana Iceshriek sounds like the one that's spurring the harpies to be more aggressive. If we kill her, I suspect their attacks won't last long afterwards.$B$BOne of our stormriders claims to have spotted her circling the peak directly northwest of here.  Go find the wench and put her down. Let's see this done.

1403c975c07902d7892c31625f98b22551437826.comment: Bluegill Warrior - Out of Combat - Cast 'Battle Stance' (No Repeat)

1405b4e22b00a5a5dca814e94f771b12b5fb0765.LogDescription: Kill Chok'sul and bring his head to Magistrate Bluntnose of Thelsamar.
1405b4e22b00a5a5dca814e94f771b12b5fb0765.QuestDescription: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:$b$bChok'sul, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.$b$bMonetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of Chok'sul's death.$b$bChok'sul was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of Loch Modan.

14092c43455fc05f587527d940e2a54e20befd9d.LogDescription: Bring the pieces for the spirit totem to Bath'rah the Windwatcher.
14092c43455fc05f587527d940e2a54e20befd9d.QuestDescription: The elemental spirits of this place don't be likin' me any more.$b$bYou know about the totems more than any, and I be needin' a spirit totem to protect me.  We already got the elements, now we need somethin' more with more nature.  More primal.$b$bIn the Western Plaguelands you can kill bears for claws and spiders for their eyes.  The carrion birds eat everything, so they might have either one.

140ccd8b9f40aac36540fd41939d78753da049a2.LogDescription: Keritose Bloodblade at the Shadow Vault wants you to use the Eidolon Watcher to feed 18 Hungering Plaguehounds.
140ccd8b9f40aac36540fd41939d78753da049a2.QuestDescription: As is usual practice, the undead at the saronite quarry to the southwest starve plaguehounds to keep them extra aggressive. Use the shade to get up close and feed some of those hounds and I promise you they'll be content to leave you alone, if not side with the hand that fed them.$B$BDon't get too close to those things until you've fed them though. Their noses don't fall victim to your shade's elusiveness.

140d15cec5283cb02742fa4da660337e9bef7541.Text: You dare challenge Winterskorn?! I will impale you ON your own puny flag!

140e6caaf0bc041d4ff546b78fa0eccccfdb5716.Text: Soft, vulnerable shells. Brief fragile lives. You cannot escape the curse of flesh!

141d179ee150d4c14dc9bf1f52e2349ba97bffac.Text: Don't worry about that. I've increased production at the Deathforge. You'll have all the infernals you need to carry out your orders. Don't fail, Jovaan.

142224c3597d9e9992a34915315a11f21171a4b8.LogDescription: Speak with Sky Commander Keller at the Skyguard Outpost in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
142224c3597d9e9992a34915315a11f21171a4b8.QuestDescription: $N, we were wondering if you might be willing to visit our friends just to the north at the Skyguard Outpost?$B$BSky Commander Keller and his Skyguard are here running missions for our mutual protection, and he's asked us to send along anyone that we feel would excel at helping out.$B$BThat would be you!$B$BHead up there as soon as you can, and please, give him our regards.

14236d2150d8c8e20c1368ef151ac751eb50a761.Text: The rod's design is simple. Dartol didn't use his arcane knowledge in its creation... it is more druidic in nature.

142563c0ed8ac6e0008b2de2b300a87862c0c32a.Text: Don't leave me again!  You want to fight for your country, but they don't even want you!  They sent you here to die!

1430a81897d0d731154f98a95afea93060b96136.Text: Hello, Charys. I have my list, could you get me all of that, especially the last ingredient.

1430d5b3121297bd5a6bcf331e87e89bc42e55f2.LogDescription: Bring 6 Sawtooth Snapper Claws to Tok'Kar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
1430d5b3121297bd5a6bcf331e87e89bc42e55f2.QuestDescription: With the threat of murlocs along the coast, we're stationed out here to protect--or warn if the force is too large--of any coming threats to Stonard. It doesn't give us much time for relaxation, and we could use some more help if you're able.$B$BThe sawtooth snappers' claws make for fine weapons when properly prepared. Bring me some of their claws and I'll see you're rewarded with one of our weapons in thanks for the fresh meat and the good company.

1440f49c7d3d261d1623804f77a4e1d47abb0189.LogDescription: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
1440f49c7d3d261d1623804f77a4e1d47abb0189.LogTitle: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...
1440f49c7d3d261d1623804f77a4e1d47abb0189.QuestDescription: As I was saying, $c, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.$B$BThis is where you come in, $N. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.

144234fffb3d7b2bb0264c432ade263cdb4c36f3.Text: My liege, the infiltration and control of the Alliance power structure by our cultists is well underway.

14449ace1eaf4004d014019a111c70e5f204f0ff.LogDescription: Nat Pagle at Nat's Landing wants you to test his new fish bait.
14449ace1eaf4004d014019a111c70e5f204f0ff.QuestDescription: So you found a copy of Dastardly Denizens of the Deep, did you? Well, I can tell you from experience, it's all true. I've even seen a few of 'em with my own eyes.$B$BBut you want to know about Tethyr.  I said I'd make you a deal, so here's what I want you to do. I'm working on a new line of baits, but I haven't tested this one yet.$B$BJust take this paste -- yeah, it smells a little foul -- smear it on yourself, and swim over to that wrecked ship to the southwest. If you survive, let me know how it works!

14480d98ccb445759793cdd23669432f7522495e.RewardText: It has been long since any have come to talk with me...

144aba75bc71490ed5474a96e3011f6213cfaf9f.LogDescription: Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Saelienne, and in exchange you'll receive Darnassus Marzipan!
144aba75bc71490ed5474a96e3011f6213cfaf9f.QuestDescription: Even though you're trick-or-treating for a sick child, you still need to perform a trick for the treat!  We can't very well change the tradition, now can we...$B$BI believe the cost of a piece of marzipan nowadays is to bust out and DANCE!  That's right, let me see your moves!  Dance for me, and I'll give you some tasty marzipan!

145b47a09cb680c052f38ce8a2189d5363351166.QuestDescription: We believe there is one being that may be able to help us understand what is happening to the forests of Teldrassil. Unfortunately, getting the creature to cooperate has proven disastrous.$B$BHe hides on a branch at the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. All who have so far approached the satyr, whether through force or diplomacy, have met with doom. Perhaps stealth is the answer, $N.$B$BFind what Sethir the Ancient carries in his packs and report back to me.$B

145d0203b07241ece098da5bc439f3da90b5da51.comment: Deviate Crocolisk - In Combat - Cast Tendon Rip

1463129b4f8513aaf975ee43d8172964d304889d.LogDescription: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.
1463129b4f8513aaf975ee43d8172964d304889d.QuestDescription: Your findings are incredible, $N.  These oases hold properties that must come from an outside source.  Or perhaps an inside one.$B$BI want to know how these fissures are affecting the beasts who drink from the oases' water.$B$BHunt oasis snapjaws at the Lushwater and Stagnant Oases.  Bring me their shells so I may examine them.

146434495052a06a3941d2b607068f10141373fa.RewardText: Oh, those look splendid.  These cultists certainly have an eye for craftsmanship.$B$BToo bad for them that it's misdirected.$B$BAnd now that we have the nets, would you be willing to help little old me with a thing or two?

14669b40215998a21cfda825cfb3181da26698f9.RewardText: The val'kyr are nothing but the Lich King's lapdogs.  They will be put down like the scum they are.  They've made their choice, now they have to live with the consequences.

146b420db6e14f2638b12ab3253753417a41628a.LogDescription: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
146b420db6e14f2638b12ab3253753417a41628a.QuestDescription: $N!  Your aid is needed in Feralas!$B$BAn outlaw mage, Lethtendris, has fled to the ancient elven ruins Eldre'thalas, now called Dire Maul.  It is believed she has an item of dangerous magical energy which must be recovered.$B$BLatronicus Moonspear requests agents to enter Dire Maul and retrieve the item from Lethtendris.$B$BServe the Alliance!  Seek out Latronicus at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

1479c27dbaf1e390020b4b3c6c3c1ca6323c36d4.LogDescription: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.
1479c27dbaf1e390020b4b3c6c3c1ca6323c36d4.QuestDescription: We Trolls here at Malaka'Jin have prospered from the land; Stonetalon Mountain offers great hunting for us to live on.$B$BLately, we have attracted the wrong dinner guests... the spiders in these mountains have been raiding our camps at night looking to steal our hunt.$B$BIf you were to help us kill off these ghastly beasts we at Malaka'Jin would be in your debt. Spiders are everywhere in Stonetalon - just head north from here and you will see what I am talking about.

1484ed07a8736d7b676d0345d6a4ed49e923c3c1.comment: Thomas Partridge - On Waypoint 1 Reached - Pause Waypoint

14866793cbc195f20f10b53059b0a017b9b7a6ec.Text: Your life for the Lich King!

148a1adab3c40a8fd32c4f142cc97121f0c975fa.LogDescription: Take Mildred's Key to Lok'lira the Crone in the Forlorn Mine.
148a1adab3c40a8fd32c4f142cc97121f0c975fa.QuestDescription: You are without mercy.  You will do well around these parts.$B$BI have another task to ask of you.  There is a female vrykul prisoner that's become more of a liability than I had anticipated.$B$BShe had the gall to claim the right to take part in the Hyldsmeet, our sacred competition of strength and fighting prowess.$B$BHere's the key to her shackles.  Make it as painless as possible.  She's a female after all, even if not one of us.

148ba9a884fdca9fefc1237692ef297fda06819a.OptionText: I would like to go to the battleground.

148f53d0c3c64c64f6cd5f66c79b0967d8cf2104.RewardText: You are formidable indeed.$B$BWith Grom'thar the Thunderbringer gone, we can leave the remaining Magnataur to fight among themselves and turn our attentions back towards more prominent threats.$B$BImpressive work, $c.

149090d2415da101fcc1c7a293410460993063be.LogDescription: Torthen Deepdig at the Westfall Brigade Encampment wants you to decipher the three Rune Plates.
149090d2415da101fcc1c7a293410460993063be.QuestDescription: We've no time to lose! Now that we've reassembled the runic keystone -- well, most of it -- we can decipher the contents of those very same runic plates Brann was working on before he fled.$B$BWe have no way of knowing if he managed to read the contents of all three plates, but we'll have to assume he got enough information to determine his next destination.$B$BStand before each of the plates and use the keystone to determine the contents of each. Brann may be counting on us!

1490f0e683e09a155c1eba85cad521605c503be8.RewardText: It's good to see another new arrival here at Forest Song.$B$BVindicator Palanaar is sending as much help as she can muster and each set of hands is appreciated.$B$BTake a look around, $c. It may not be much now, but with time and help from our night elf allies, we'll build a settlement worthy of calling home. There is much to be done here and any help you can provide would be welcome.

1491119b4d19807f2649a98911fbde25c380484b.RewardText: I knew it!$B$BEven my going missing wasn't enough to get those spineless weasels to come in here after me.$B$BWell, they sent you. I suppose that's something....$B$BHere, take this. I'd rather it go to you than to those dimwits back at the camp.

1491183c22058512518adbe043d4a9708a6bfa45.name: Tempest Keep Prison Alpha Pod Target

1492756822476c9b2fb11d4bf9ddc7acccfc1697.RewardText: Aw, prime specimens!$b$bYou can see there the divergence from the root symbology. Quite extraordinary.$b$bWhat a pity that the ice trolls are determined to bring about their own demise.$b$bDid you know, for instance, that the Drakkari were exiled from the rest of the troll nations for their extremely violent ways?$b$bIt's true! How did you think trolls ended up in such a harsh climate as this?

1493304a80d9b57e1178b3d0519051597871bbd3.LogDescription: Find the Mysterious Artifact being guarded by the Twilight's Hammer Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the Searing Gorge and bring it to the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.$B
1493304a80d9b57e1178b3d0519051597871bbd3.QuestDescription: Release them, $r. Even after their bodies give out, the power of the Suntara forces them to complete their tasks.$B$BThe altar of Suntara is the key. Go northwest; in the hills above the cave... Twilight's Hammer guard a relic. Retrieve it and place it on the altar of Suntara.$B$B<The dying archaeologist collapses.>

14956035b03720ffe72c3da1ad9b0308d09b8dab.RewardText: Excellent - the more water pouches we are able to reclaim, the further away from disaster we'll all be!  Keep 'em coming, and I will be sure to reward you for every five water pouches you bring me.

14ac5f028f6444aac3b589ab64afa58472c4481e.LogDescription: Slay 10 Nerubis Guards and then return to Arcanist Vandril at Tranquillien in the Ghostlands.
14ac5f028f6444aac3b589ab64afa58472c4481e.QuestDescription: We're surrounded here, $c.  The outlying villages have all been overrun by the Scourge!$B$BYou must head northeast to Suncrown Village immediately and deal with the Nerubian Scourge menace.  You can't miss them - they're spider-like creatures.$B$BThere's no time to waste.... Quel'Thalas must be reclaimed!

14adecac6d196d74b411fa5712799256d8f61f9b.Text: Staghelm and his armies were clearly overwhelmed as the endless flow of Rajaxx's troops poured into Silithus. It would seem as if Staghelm, however, was more than just a nuisance to the Qiraji. Under Staghelm, the whole of the night elf armies had come together to defend Kalimdor, greatly slowing the Qiraji forces.

14af6ec16cdd53b8e636bec21a3e70e5352699c9.comment: Lord Aliden Perenolde - In Combat - Cast 'Power Word: Shield' (No Repeat)

14b0484136396157dea0989d1ff16fdd4993896a.LogDescription: Bring the Sealed Letter to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
14b0484136396157dea0989d1ff16fdd4993896a.QuestDescription: Recovered from the body of a Forsaken apothecary, this letter hints at an underground correspondence between Undercity and the Grimtotem leadership.$B$B"As a demonstration of good faith and a symbol of our newfound trust, we have dispatched Apothecary Cylla to aid you in battling our mutual enemy in the land of Kalimdor. None will stand before our combined might and determination."$B$BPerhaps Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village will know how to handle this information.

It sounds like he's far away, to the east.$B$BI hope he's not crying for me!  $N, will you find my uncle and tell him I'm alright?$B$BIf you find him say I'm waiting for him, and I want to hear the story he used to tell... the one about the rabbits and the berry jam!  That story's so funny!

14be93a5911db16a033f009bc7be0649f6c972e8.CompletionText: $N, you have returned. What news of Ulfang?

14c0da964a7a6d2c7dd8f7f5c68369f3a8aada2d.LogDescription: Use the Chieftain's Totem to close 4 Frostfloe Rifts, then bring the totem to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
14c0da964a7a6d2c7dd8f7f5c68369f3a8aada2d.QuestDescription: This, the tomb of Tunka'lo's warriors, is supposed to be a serene place, free from the terror of the elements.$B$BFrostfloe Deep has been invaded by a strange force, one that disturbs the spirits of the fallen and blurs my memories of my own life.$B$BIt's as though our deeds and memories are being erased from history.$B$BIn life, this totem was a symbol of my authority. It is the last true link I have to this world. Take it, use it to restore calm to the tomb, and then return it to Camp Tunka'lo.

14c15ff9ffa41fcc633b9a446c1d682f55230b30.comment: Ethereal Beacon - Update - Cast Summon Ethereal Apprentice

14c83558241855b220956f114c6e64a774ba9731.Text: Accessing... Creators arrived to extirpate symbiotic infection. Assessment revealed that Old God infestation had grown malignant. Excising parasites would result in loss of host--

14c83c33994e329dec6d67d7df4ee637f8dc4ddf.LogDescription: Mor'vek in Un'goro Crater claims that if you were poisoned by Venomhide Ravasaur blood 20 times, you could ride one without dying. Attack Venomhide Ravasaurs for a chance to be poisoned.
14c83c33994e329dec6d67d7df4ee637f8dc4ddf.QuestDescription: You want to ride a Venomhide? Then I've got bad news for you.$B$BThe Venomhide Ravasaurs, they're all poison: Poison blood, poison spit, poison skin. You climb on one, you fall off dead in a few hours.$B$BYou'd have to build up a resistance to their toxins before I sold you one, and that takes a long, LONG time... you'd need to be splashed with poisonous blood while fighting one numerous times. If you're really interested, the venomhides prefer the northern area of of the Marshlands, northwest of here.

parent_speech.Text: Alas, brave, brave adventurers, your meddling has reached its end. Do you hear the clatter of bone and steel coming up the tunnel behind you? That is the sound of your impending demise.
Ha, such an amusing gesture from the rabble. When I have finished with you, my master's blade will feast upon your souls. Die.
I shall not fail the Lich King. Come and meet your end!
Such a shameful display. You are better off dead.
Perhaps you should have stayed... in the mountains!
